name: linux-input-ime
title: Port Linux text input and IME
description: Implement the Linux native input/IME adapter and target bridge using the existing portable text_input state machine.
scope: Linux native IME/input adapter and EU4 bridge
creator: charl
notes: Canonical SDL adapter and 10 target patches implemented. System SDL dynamic API enables Fcitx; user confirmed Chinese input/display. Inherited CEditBox edits now intercepted at function entry; real ELF regression reproduces base-vtable bypass and passes after fix. Await final user deletion confirmation. Final installed revision was restarted; user confirmed deletion and map spacing now work correctly. Broader unverified scenarios remain documented.
